summary: Wrote arch/arch.yaml with top counter8 (ports_from_spec) and two submodules, cnt_ctrl and cnt_dp. cnt_ctrl encodes load/enable/up_down into a 2-bit op code (load > enable priority). cnt_dp holds the only state element, the 8-bit count register. That register has a synchronous active-low reset that overrides everything and an output driven directly from flops. All 13 REQs are mapped. The PPA numbers are hand estimates, not tool output. No schema validator or estimator was run in this task, so no check is claimed as passed.
assumptions: No synthesis data exists, so the model is uncalibrated. Error band: cells -10%/+60%, delay +/-50%, power about 3x.
No tool was run; all numbers are hand estimates from typical sky130_fd_sc_hd figures (dfxtp_1 about 20 um2, nand2_1 3.75 um2, xor2_1 8.76 um2, mux2_1 11.26 um2). Estimates, not measured values.
PPA numbers (about 70 cells, depth 10, 60% slack) are hand estimates; I have not run the estimator or a Yosys sketch.
Port names, up_down polarity (1=up), load-while-enable=0 allowed, wrap on overflow/underflow and priority reset > load > enable are taken from the spec DEFAULTs, which still need G1 review.
Single clock domain with all inputs synchronous to clk, so there are no CDC entries, per the spec out-of-scope list.
Switching activity 10-20% on count bits, 100 MHz, 1.8 V, for the power estimate.
Synchronous reset is implemented as logic in front of a plain D flop (dfxtp), as sky130 hd has no sync-reset flop.
Synthesis is ABC-style with no explicit adder architecture, giving a ripple-style incrementer/decrementer.
Typical corner (tt, 1.8 V, 25 C) for delay and power; slow corner could add about 1.5-2x delay. Spec has not pinned the corners.
rst_n is applied only in cnt_dp, since the sole state element is count and there is no other state to reset.
state_machines is empty because the design has no FSM; the op encoding is combinational.
open_issues: A cell count of 70 is optimistic: 8 flops plus an up/down incrementer (8 XOR plus carry chain), a 4:1 mux per bit (about 8 mux4 or 16+ gates), reset gating (8 and-type cells) and a decode of 3-5 cells. My range is 65-120 cells.
Corners and sky130A release not pinned (spec open question); the timing margin depends on them.
Estimates need confirmation by the estimator or Yosys synthesis.
Fan-out: input enable, up_down and load drive about 8 loads each via op; buffers may add cells.
Hold timing on input ports depends on the flow's input delay constraints, which are not specified.
Recommend a first synthesis and STA run (yosys/OpenSTA) to calibrate this model; handover to the synthesis agent.
Spec open questions (load while enable=0, carry flag, sky130A release and STA corners) remain for G1.
Spec says power and area targets are out of scope; no target exists, so area and power cannot be judged pass/fail.

arch.yaml 'critical_path_levels: 10' and 'slack_margin_pct: 60' have no derivation. I estimate 6-9 levels and a slack of roughly 60-80% at tt, falling to about 40-70% at slow corners. The figures are consistent with each other but not validated.

cnt_dp max_logic_depth 10 plus cnt_ctrl depth 2 gives a total of about 12 levels if the op decode is in series; the arch counts only 10. Recommend the architect clarify whether the 10 includes control.

messages.summary: Hand estimate: about 8 flops plus roughly 60-110 combinational cells, so the arch figure of 70 cells is plausible but at the low end (my range is 65-120). Realistic depth is 6-9 levels, not exactly 10; at about 0.15-0.4 ns per level in sky130 hd this is roughly 2-4 ns, well inside 10 ns. Timing is not a risk. The 60% slack_margin_pct is unsupported and probably overstated. Spec has no area or power targets, so those are reported only as estimates. No past synthesis exists, so there is no calibration; error band is about -10%/+60% on cells and about +/-50% on delay. Everything here needs confirmation by synthesis and STA, and I ran no tools.

self_assessment.reason: The structure is simple and well known and the port widths are consistent by construction. The file is not yet schema-validated and the PPA figures are unverified hand estimates.
